children: Brazil's government on Thursday widened its forecast for this year's primary deficit to 80.9 billion reais ($15.61 billion), from 52 billion reais projected in July.
The shortfall is equivalent to 0.59% of gross domestic product (GDP), according to the government's bimonthly revenue and expenditure report.
The report also indicated the government will need to freeze a total of 16.1 billion reais in spending to comply with fiscal rules, the Planning Ministry said in a presentation.
